clue.text: Can be thought of as large

taken as written

clue.text: Called to take part in a medical

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: When editor is replaced to get a bit of space

clue.text: Showed aversion to trial, in fact

explanation.definitionFit: To loathe something is to have a strong aversion to it.

definitions.meaning: a set of eggs laid together in one nest

explanation.definitionFit: To grip something tightly is to seize it; a brood of eggs laid at one time in a nest has the same name.

parts.note: a magic incantation is a charm, while a stint or shift of work is a turn; one word covers both

indicators.note: a break-down means the letters of crop pest are broken up and reassembled

clue.text: Lonely and half in debt — consequently delayed

clue.text: Spoil three notes — in front of expert!

clue.text: Workshop boss has one with nothing to follow

parts.note: with out, to leave out is to omit

parts.note: Lent is a season of fasting, so food fit for a fast; the phrase is really quick takeaway meals
